title: USG-UAP-D001, Congressional, White House, UFO-related Constituent Correspondence, 1998
what_is_it: A collection of correspondence from the White House and Congressional offices responding to constituent inquiries about UFOs, dated 1998.
interpretation_warnings: The source is an image file (IMG type) and OCR extraction yielded almost no readable text — only fragmentary words.
Nearly all substantive information comes from the CSV metadata description rather than the extracted source text itself.
The document collection references materials of both confirmed and unconfirmed authenticity as provided by constituents.
Claims about government positions on UFOs are drawn from metadata, not directly verifiable from the extracted text.
